warnings: Two drawings of the same truss mark T1: a steel truss and a hardwood alternative (each sheet S-10 / S-11 carries the matching roof notes). The steel one keeps element_id T1 (the set's roof frame plan S-04 draws a steel frame: steel purlins C-100x50x20x3.2); the wood alternative takes element_id null so one sheet does not carry two members under one id (section 0.3).

Section symbols for the steel chord/king post print as a double angle (⊥⊥); designation recorded as L with the printed text kept (key mapping as in house 157's truss B). Whether the chord is one or two angles is left to printed_as.

Both drawings print the bearing chain 1.60 | 6.50 | 2.00 | 1.60 and the height '~1.35' between 'ระดับหัวเสา' and 'ระดับสันหลังคา' (recorded in the grid master); the '~' is printed, so the rise is approximate.
